text: Chunking is configured in config.yml (vector: chunk_size 500, chunk_overlap 50, top_k 5, score_threshold 0.35, experience_score_threshold 0.55). After any content write/update/move you must call kb_index_document or kb_reindex and confirm vector_index.collection matches the parent KB with total_chunks ≥ 1 — stale vectors are the top cause of missed searches. Layer 5 is a Neo4j knowledge graph keyed on graph_doc_id (Document/Tag/KB nodes, cross-KB entity merge), NER via transformers after HanLP was dropped as TF-incompatible; built by non-blocking kb_graph_build (total_relations counts new relations only) and optional (--no-neo4j). Tests: hermetic test_unit.py via uv run pytest, integration gated by --run-integration, plus validate_skills.cjs (8 cross-skill checks). Ten quality gates include zero hardcoded paths, config.yml as single source of truth, httpx trust_env=False, five-layer atomicity, and verify-before-done.
